workstream: P5 / AC1018-AC1021 TABLE title/header/data row color and fill overrides

authority.dwgDocument: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1

dxfFields.63: background/fill color, repeated per cell type
dxfFields.64: cell-content color, repeated per cell type
dxfFields.283: background-color enabled, repeated per cell type

authority.limitation: Autodesk's group-code reference does not establish the order of repeated cell-type values. The implementation uses ODA's DWG title/header/data order; generated controls do not qualify physical DXF producer order or native precedence.

implementation.behavior: TABLE entity-level group 64 text colors, group 63 fill colors, and group 283 fill-enabled values now map to/from the three modeled title/header/data slots. Group 283 is inverted from DWG fillNone. CMC output is admitted only for exact ByLayer (C0/index 256), ByBlock (C1/index 0), or indexed ACI (C3/index 1..255), with no extra flags, RGB payload, color name, or color book. Unsupported true-color/name/book companions, invalid indices, malformed/missing/excess selected values, and orphaned values fail closed. Cell-level overrides remain distinct.

generatedControl: From-scratch TABLE tags exercise all three selected slots with cell-level and entity-level values interleaved, verify group-code order and exact values, parseback typed fields, and reject missing, excess, malformed, invalid, true-color, and color-book cases without partial state publication.
outputControl: ASCII and Binary adapter output verify exact group 63/64/283 values, fresh typed readback, atomic destination preservation on unsupported CMC, and corrected same-writer retry.
limits: Generated codec mapping only; no physical DXF repeated-value order witness, producer breadth, native precedence, or rendering qualification.
Only exact CMC index methods are represented; other color methods and group 420/430 companions remain unsupported.
No broader TABLE, whole-drawing, or product support claim is promoted.
next: Resolve selected row text-style hard pointers to unique emitted STYLE names through a staged registry; retain fail-closed behavior for missing, duplicate, wrong-type, or un-emitted targets. Keep group 140 text height, row heights, and borders output-refused absent exact mapping and ordering proof.
